candidate.name: scm_online
candidate.representation: Mean16 plus lower-triangular L in existing full256-double array, P=L*L^T; exact numeric zeros above diagonal, nonnegative diagonal, rank deficiency allowed. No history cache.
candidate.belief_semantics: Local Gaussian, prior-conditioned approximation to sequential nonlinear inference. Historical information is carried in mean/full factor and dynamics; no exact nonlinear historical likelihood or hard support/coverage claim.
candidate.prior_means: Original public defaulttheta start0: geometric-mid tau bands, gamma150/300,Q.06,z.68. Legacy linear-QP public seed R0/R1/R2/R3=.1,H=.024; currentv1/v2/v3/h=0. No fitted M1 estimates or true values.
candidate.prior_standard_deviations: Support-coordinate width/sqrt12: log tau bands [.015,.15],[.15,1.5],[1.5,30]; loggamma[5,1200]; logQ[.03,.10]; R[0,1],H[0,.1],enteringz[.2,.95],enteringv[-.08,.08],h[-1,1]. Diagonal initial factor; this is a declared Gaussian scale, not a uniform-support guarantee.
candidate.prediction: Same actual-interval physical dynamics and sparse F*L. Static-first coordinate order makes F lower-triangular, so initial diagonal L remains lower-triangular; no QR, process noise or forgetting.
candidate.correction: One Joseph covariance for the actual component-wise selected gain K=t/innovation_sd, full correlations retained; each voltage enters once.
candidate.domain_policy: For active g_i!=0, compute raw_i=g_i*(innovation/sd). lambda_i starts1 and is independently reduced to available mean distance/raw_i only if raw_i points past a bound; clamp[0,1], apply existing1-1e-9 interior backoff only when lambda_i<1. Set t_i=lambda_i*g_i. Commit mean increment t_i*(innovation/sd), validate it without an independent mean clip.
candidate.factor_formula: Conceptual A=[[sigma,h^T L],[0,L]]. Descending right rotations j15..0 between noise column and Lcolumn j yield [[sd,0],[g,Lopt]], so Lopt*Lopt^T=P-g*g^T. Then Pnew=Lopt*Lopt^T+(g-t)*(g-t)^T. Ascending rotations j0..15 between lower column j and appended d=g-t produce the full chosen-gain Joseph lower factor.
candidate.mean_support: Static original supports; current z[0,1],v_i[-.25,.25]V,h[-1,1]. Support checking constrains means; covariance remains local approximate, not truncated posterior.
candidate.work: At most136 gradient multiply-accumulate terms,16 descending rotations/136 row-pair updates,16 ascending rotations/120 below-pivot row-pair updates and32hypot; fixedO(16^2) plus existing prediction/copies/validation. Not a target cycle bound.
candidate.rank_deficiency: First rotation norm>=sigma>0; second uses hypot(L_jj,d_j), skips identity when d_j==0 and never divides by a bare diagonal. No rank threshold, floor or injected variance.
candidate.transactions: Validate input and stage physical prediction/known ledger first; commit valid prediction to live state, then mutate only existing workspace.candidate during correction. Commit corrected candidate only after all finite/domain/triangular/metadata/observation checks pass. Any correction failure keeps live prediction and records rejected voltage. Negative input failures remain atomic.
candidate.exact_noop: If all actual t_i==0, copy the retained predicted mean/factor bytes exactly; do not rely on a round-trip of rotations. Zero innovation with nonzero gain still conditions covariance and advances evidence.

diagnostics.last_gain_scale: Minimum lambda_i over active g_i!=0;1 if none.
diagnostics.last_max_gain_scale: Maximum lambda_i over active g_i!=0;1 if none.
diagnostics.minimum_gain_scale: Minimum of last_gain_scale during this belief epoch; coldreset starts1.
diagnostics.last_limited_mask: 16-bit bit i for active coordinate with lambda_i<1.
diagnostics.last_blocked_mask: 16-bit bit i for active coordinate with actual selected t_i==0; includes any numerical vanishing of a limited component.
diagnostics.limited_gain_count: Cumulative voltage updates with nonzero limited mask.
diagnostics.zero_gain_count: Cumulative voltage updates for which all actual t_i are zero, including zero sensitivity; not equivalent to min lambda==0.
diagnostics.evidence: Advance only if some t_i is nonzero. No-sensitivity observation adds no belief availability. All counters survive coldreset; suffix counts subtract reset values.

checkpoint.identity: SCMONLN2 magic, model A4SREKF2; reject v1/nontriangular state explicitly. No conversion/import of predecessor posterior.

expected_host_objects_bytes.note: Forecast before compile;16B diagnostics appear in state, candidate and query. No new fullmatrix or vector; complete own-stack and runtime/target extras measured separately.

execution.primary_run_policy: Run once after source/plan commit. Preserve first outputs and any failures. No full-cell learning during development. Tiny deterministic numerical/fault fixtures are separately disclosed.
execution.truth_policy: Inference runner/CLI receives observations and public configuration only. Separate scorer loads truth after every inference process has finished.
execution.checkpoint: Fixed2456B version2 complete lower factor/config/diagnostics/ledger. Exact warm restore, no observation assimilation; reject v1.
execution.cold: Restorecontrol900s then discardbelief and initialize the declared public prior while plant continues. Source position and known absoluteclock retained; no true hidden state.

acceptance.functional: Every declared process/delivery completes with explicit finite-state/ordering/lifecycle semantics; exact warmcheckpoint and queryparity excludingruntime timings. No silently lost physical updates or duplicated observation evidence.
acceptance.resource: No heap in inference kernel, no rawhistory, owned persistent/workspace/query bytes constant from first tolast observation; practical initial owned budget8192B before stack/runtime/persistence extras. Record all additional simultaneous costs.
acceptance.qualification: Keep the same local status thresholds and semantics as001. Count all saved-query provisional SOC errors>10pp or capacity errors>5%; promotion requires zero such breaches. This diagnostic is not validated coverage. Report unavailable/unresolved periods and first/sustained point performance separately.
acceptance.comparison_reference: Frozen bounded_online_001 and M1 scores at same positions; no inference reruns. Current-vector chart matches001; M1 entering-state aggregate is separate.
acceptance.decision: Keep/promote only if lifecycle,resource,numerical-health,hard target and provisional-hard-error audit gates all pass. Preferred .5/.5 is reported separately. Fewer stalls alone is not sufficient. Preserve first failure and stop with one measured next blocker; no postscore retuning or duration extension.

scope_of_change: One component-wise feasible measurement gain and its matching general Joseph factor. Representation becomes lower-triangular; diagnostics/checkpoint identity change. Prior means/scales, physical model, supports, data, no-process-noise/no-forgetting policy and local status thresholds unchanged.
development: Only decisive deterministic algebra, fault and checkpoint tests plus zero-stream driver smoke before source/plan commit. No full-cell inference before the single primary.
artifact_io: Write completed JSON/plot/log artifacts atomically where practical; preserve first outputs and any failure; no streaming rewrite of frozen receipts.
risk: Removing global limiter stall may not repair nonlinear Gaussian bias/overconfidence. Orthogonal factor arithmetic has finite tests, not all-prefix stability/coverage or M23 qualification.
proof_scope: Independent algebra for chosen-gain Joseph and triangular ordering, meaningful dense-oracle/rank-deficient/fault tests. No new general theorem program.
